name: How often does an interior log home need to be stained again?
description: There is no single schedule for every home. Many Colorado log homes are inspected yearly and restained every 3 to 5 years when the finish starts to wear.

mainEntity.name: How often does an interior log home need to be stained again?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most log homes do not need interior restaining on a fixed yearly schedule; the timing depends on wear, sun exposure, and how the original finish is holding up. Colorado log home guidance commonly recommends annual inspection and re-staining every 3 to 5 years when maintenance is needed.
